title: JourneyReceipt
description: The aggregate receipt of a full nine-step endpoint-originated validation journey (ADR-068 §31, §21 step 9). It seals the eight technical OperationReceipts plus the Certification Readiness step, binding the whole result to the implementation's canonical origin. `certification_readiness` is READY or BLOCKED; `certification_status` is always NOT_CERTIFIED and `certified` is always false — the journey aggregates verdicts, it NEVER issues a Certification Record and NEVER returns CERTIFIED (ADR-068 §4.10, ADR-066). Documentary/reference contract; introduces no new financial invariant.
_authority: ADR-068 (§31 JourneyReceipt, §21 step 9, §4.10), ADR-076 (§D-076-08 durable append-only persistence, retry/reproduction lineage), ADR-077 (profile applicability model — applicability summary + readiness over REQUIRED-only steps), ADR-066 (closed certification-state machine), ADR-061 (certification ≠ admission ≠ authorisation)
_boundary: A journey receipt records what was fetched and what Rust decided across the journey. It never certifies, admits, authorises, or moves funds. It carries NO free BanzAI/model text (ADR-076 §D-076-08); the model never decides a verdict.

step_count.description: Number of receipts (nine: eight technical + certification readiness).

steps.description: The ordered OperationReceipts of the journey.

overall_status.description: Aggregate of the technical step statuses that APPLY to the profile, decided in Rust. NOT_APPLICABLE steps (ADR-077) are excluded — they never contribute FAILED/BLOCKED/PENDING.

certification_readiness.description: Aggregate readiness over the steps REQUIRED for the profile. READY only when every REQUIRED step is VERIFIED (ADR-077 excludes NOT_APPLICABLE steps). Never CERTIFIED.

applicability.description: ADR-077: the Rust-decided step→applicability map for this profile (each of the eight technical steps → REQUIRED | OPTIONAL | NOT_APPLICABLE). Orthogonal to per-step result.status.

not_applicable_steps.description: ADR-077: the technical steps that are NOT_APPLICABLE for this profile (out of scope; not fetched or evaluated).

required_steps_evaluated.description: ADR-077: count of profile-REQUIRED technical steps aggregated into readiness.

certification_status.description: Always NOT_CERTIFIED. The journey never issues a Certification Record (ADR-066).

reason_codes.description: Reason codes explaining the outcome. They never decide it — the decision is the status field. Core codes are published in contracts/production/reason-code-registry.production.json; additional codes MUST use the reserved extension namespace x-<vendor>.<code> and MUST NOT be interpreted by a consumer. Ordering is not significant. See spec/reason-codes.md.

protocol_fetch_count.description: Total successful protocol fetches across the journey.

disclaimer.description: Human-readable boundary notice: endpoint-originated, Rust-decided, readiness is not a Certification Record.

previous_journey_id.description: ADR-076 §D-076-08: when this run is a retry, the journey_id it supersedes. A retry creates a NEW record linked to the prior; it never rewrites it.

reproduction_of.description: ADR-076 §D-076-08: when this run is a reproduction from pinned artefacts, the original journey_id it reproduces. The reproduction is a NEW execution and never overwrites the original.

reproduction_result.description: ADR-076 §D-076-08: set only when reproduction_of is present. A reproduction re-runs the FULL secure pipeline (registry-resolved origin + secure fetch + DNS/IP/TLS validation), NEVER a fetch to a URL stored in the receipt, then compares the newly observed artefact hashes against the original.
